boundaries: Fly damage and protection read the same named coin, without a second roll.
Tenacious Body requires lethal attack damage; damage counters and direct knockouts do not qualify.
Whole-text damage gates do not silently gate only damage when additional text remains.
Bench damage counters require an opponent Bench target, not an arbitrary Active target.
Typed searches retain Basic identity, hidden deck failure-to-find and exact public reveal/Bench placement semantics.
Teal Dance attaches to the originating Active or Bench Pokemon; it cannot draw without the attachment, and does not spend the ordinary turn attachment.
Unrecognized companion attacks, abilities and structural fields remain unsupported; candidate partial combat data is not counted as complete card support.
